name: @ocs/format
//: Text formats: URL, HTML entities, JWT, JSON, XML, case, UUID, password. Unlike every other family here, almost none of this is implemented in the repo -- each tool is a catalogue over a mature library, because one exists for each job and a second implementation would add a way to be wrong rather than a way to be right. See the note in src/index.ts for what each dependency is and why it was chosen. `./manifests` is eager and dependency-free; `./definition` is the on-demand half that pulls the libraries in.
